title: FLA binary import: scene names silently skipped for pre-MX2004 FLAs
description: flash8-binary.ts line 2208: Flash 5/MX FLAs (formatVersion < 0x38) use a bare ASCII string table in the Contents stream for scene names; the parser skips with warnOnce and imports all frames as a single unnamed scene. Fix: decode the ASCII string table and map scene names to the imported document's scenes array.
